newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon signs customs deal with Armenia.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon signs customs deal with Armenia.

text.p: Lebanon on Thursday signed a customs agreement with Armenia and more economic agreements will be signed in the future, Foreign Minister Faris Bouez said.
"We signed today a new agreement related to customs," he told reporters after talks with Armenian Foreign Minister Alexander Arzumanyan, who arrived in Beirut on a three-day official visit.
Arzumanyan was due to meet Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri later in the day and leave for Amman on Saturday morning.
More than 100,000 Lebanese citizens are of Armenian origin and are represented by seven deputies in the 128-member parliament.
